title: Remarkably Vivid
description: A Fabric 1.21.11 modpack bringing stunning vistas, rich soundscapes, and silky performance to vanilla Minecraft.
body: A **Fabric 1.21** modpack bringing stunning vistas, rich soundscapes, and silky performance to vanilla Minecraft. Featuring **Sodium**, **Iris shaders**, **Distant Horizons** & many others. With a handpicked selection of resource packs to make your world look and sound truly alive.
